family_best.title: Relative value vs BTC: fade a 2.5-sd move of coin/BTC (96 x 60m), exit at 0.5 sd, stop 2.5 ATR, 6 h, all day
family_best.rules: Track log(coin / BTC) (ETH for BTC itself) on 60-min bars; when it is more than 2.5 standard deviations from its 96-bar mean, trade the coin back toward it; exit when within 0.5 sd, after 6 h or at a 2.5 ATR stop.

family_best.title: Fisher(13) 180m fade beyond 1.4, all day
family_best.rules: Fade a 180-min Fisher transform beyond +/-1.4; stop 1.0 ATR, up to 12 h.

family_best.title: Pin 180m, 4.0R target, with trend
family_best.rules: Trade a 180-min pin candle; stop at its extreme, target 4.0R, up to 10 h.

family_best.title: Fade a 120m volume spike (1.75x volume, 0.75 ATR range), stop 2.5 ATR, 8 h, all day
family_best.rules: When a 120-min bar has more than 1.75x its 20-bar average volume and a range over 0.75 ATR, fade its direction; stop 2.5 ATR, up to 8 h.

family_best.title: Fade 4 same-colour 120m candles, all day
family_best.rules: After 4 rising (falling) 120-min candles in a row, trade the other way for 12 h; stop 3.0 ATR.

family_best.title: Asian range 00:00-06:00 UTC limit fade until 11:00, edge +0.0, stop 1.0, target middle
family_best.rules: Range = 00:00-06:00 UTC. Until 11:00 UTC rest a buy limit 0.0 range-widths below the low and a sell limit 0.0 above the high (the first filled cancels the other; maker fee); stop 1.0 range-widths beyond, target the range middle, flat at 00:00 UTC.

family_best.title: Williams %R(17) 240m beyond -94/-6, all day
family_best.rules: Buy when %R is under -94 (short over -6); exit at -50, after 8 h or at a 2.0 ATR stop.

family_best.title: Bollinger(34,2.4) 90m fade, only against the 10-day trend, stop 2.5 ATR, 20 h, all day
family_best.rules: Buy a 90-min close under the lower band (short over the upper), only against the 10-day trend; target the middle band, stop 2.5 ATR, up to 20 h.

family_best.title: RSI(10) divergence 240m (37-bar extreme, 4 pts), exit 50, stop 2.5 ATR, 16 h, all day
family_best.rules: When a 240-min close is the lowest of the last 37 bars but RSI(10) is at least 4 points above its lowest reading of the previous 37 bars, buy (mirror at highs); exit at RSI 50, after 16 h or at a 2.5 ATR stop.

family_best.title: CCI(15) 60m fade at 150, all day
family_best.rules: Fade CCI beyond +/-150; stop 1.5 ATR, up to 12 h.

family_best.title: MFI(24) 60m <26/>74, all day
family_best.rules: Buy MFI(24) under 26 (short over 74); exit at 50, after 6 h or at a 3.5 ATR stop.

family_best.title: Fade 0.5 ATR from yesterday's close (60m check), target the anchor, all day
family_best.rules: When a 60-min close is more than 0.5 daily ATR from yesterday's close, trade back toward it; stop 0.5 ATR beyond, to the end of the window.

family_best.title: EMA10 pullback 15m, 4.0R target, US hours
family_best.rules: In a rising (falling) EMA10 on 15-min bars, rest a limit at the EMA for 4 bars; stop 2.5 ATR, target 4.0R.

family_best.title: Fade 0.5 ATR from the 00:00 UTC open (60m check), target the anchor, all day
family_best.rules: When a 60-min close is more than 0.5 daily ATR from the 00:00 UTC open, trade back toward it; stop 0.5 ATR beyond, to the end of the window.

family_best.title: Pivot fade at R1/S1, all day
family_best.rules: Rest limit orders at the pivot levels; target the pivot (or R1/S1), stop one level further.

family_best.title: Classic pivot fade at level 1, all day
family_best.rules: Rest limit orders at yesterday's classic R1/S1; first touch is the trade.

family_best.title: Previous-day high/low failure 60m, stop 0.75 ATR beyond, target 3.0R, 20 h, all day
family_best.rules: When a 60-min bar trades through yesterday's high but closes back below it, sell (mirror at the low); stop 0.75 ATR beyond the bar, target 3.0R, up to 20 h.

family_best.title: Hong Kong (01:30 UTC) 10-min breakout, retest entry, 4.0R target
family_best.rules: Range = first 10 min from the Hong Kong (01:30 UTC) open; trade the first break (retest entry); stop at the far side.

family_best.title: Fade a 3.0 ATR move over 9 x 60m, with trend
family_best.rules: When price moves more than 3.0 ATR in 9 60-min bars, fade it for 8 h; stop 1.5 ATR.

family_best.title: 01:00 UTC for 3 h against the last funding print (|rate| >= 0.005%)
family_best.rules: Every day at 01:00 UTC take the side opposite to the sign of the latest funding rate when it is at least 0.005% per 8 h; close 3 h later.

family_best.title: Turtle soup 29-bar 180m, stop 0.0 ATR beyond, target 2.0R, 4 h, high-volume bars only, all day
family_best.rules: When a 180-min bar makes a new 29-bar low but closes back above the old low, buy (mirror at highs); stop 0.0 ATR beyond the bar's extreme, target 2.0R, up to 4 h.

family_best.title: 00:00-08:00 UTC range breakout until 21:00, edge +0.25, stop far side, 1.5R target, with the 10-day trend
family_best.rules: Range = 00:00-08:00 UTC. Until 21:00 UTC rest a buy stop 0.25 range-widths above the high and a sell stop 0.25 below the low (the first hit cancels the other); stop at the range far side, target 1.5R, flat at 00:00 UTC.

family_best.title: Connors RSI 240m <15/>85, exit 50, all day
family_best.rules: Buy Connors RSI under 15 (short over 85); exit at 50, after 4 h or at a 2.0 ATR stop.

family_best.title: DMI(18) cross 60m, ADX>26, European hours
family_best.rules: Long while +DI is above -DI and ADX is over 26, short the mirror.

family_best.title: VWAP 2.25-sd band limit fade on 60m (from 4 h into the day), stop 2.0 sd, 6 h, European hours
family_best.rules: After each 60-min close at least 4 h after 00:00 UTC, rest a buy limit at VWAP - 2.25 sd and a sell limit at VWAP + 2.25 sd for 2 bar(s) (the first fill cancels the other; maker fee); target VWAP, stop 2.0 sd beyond, up to 6 h.

family_best.title: Volatility breakout 0.4 x range from the NYSE open, 1.5R target, after a narrow-range day
family_best.rules: From the NYSE open, rest a buy stop 0.4 x yesterday's range above the open and a sell stop the same distance below; the first one hit is the trade (the other is cancelled); stop 0.5 daily ATR, target 1.5R, flat at 00:00 UTC.

family_best.title: Parabolic SAR(0.05) 60m, US hours
family_best.rules: Follow the Parabolic SAR side; flip on each SAR reversal.

family_best.title: Flush reversal: fade a 5.5 ATR move over 5 x 30m on 1.5x volume, target 0.5 retrace, 4 h, all day
family_best.rules: When 5 30-min bars move more than 5.5 ATR on more than 1.5x their usual volume, trade the other way; target a 0.5 retrace of the move, stop 0.25 ATR beyond its extreme, up to 4 h.

family_best.title: Bollinger(20,2.0) 30m breakout, US hours, with trend
family_best.rules: Follow a 30-min close outside the band; stop at 2 ATR, target 1.5R.

family_best.title: Fade a 2.9 ATR 180m bar
family_best.rules: Fade a 180-min bar whose range is over 2.9 ATR; hold 2 h.

family_best.title: Bollinger(18,1.75) squeeze breakout 120m (width in lowest 20% of 100 bars), 1.0R target, Asian hours
family_best.rules: After the band width sat in its lowest 20% of the last 100 bars within the previous 5 bars, follow the first 120-min close outside the bands; stop 3.0 ATR, target 1.0R, up to 16 h.

family_best.title: Supertrend 7x3.0 on 15m, US hours, with 10-day trend
family_best.rules: Follow the Supertrend (ATR 7, multiplier 3.0) direction on 15-minute bars; flat outside the window.

family_best.title: Cross-coin reversal at 06:00 UTC, 1 each side, to 00:00
family_best.rules: At 06:00 UTC rank the coins by return over the last 4 h; buy the weakest 1 and sell the strongest 1; close at 00:00 UTC.

family_best.title: Donchian(6) 90m breakout, US hours, with trend
family_best.rules: Follow a 90-min close beyond the last 6 bars' high or low; stop at 1.5 ATR, target 3.0R.

family_best.title: US pre-market breakout, retest entry, stop far, target 3R
family_best.rules: Range = 08:00-08:30 New York; trade the break from 08:30 for 2.5 h; exit at the NYSE close.

family_best.title: Lead-lag: catch up with a 2.75 ATR BTC move over 4 x 5m, lag <0.5, 2 h, US hours
family_best.rules: When BTC (ETH, for BTC itself) has moved more than 2.75 ATR over the last 4 5-min bars and this coin has moved less than 0.5 of that in its own ATR, trade this coin in BTC's direction; stop 1.5 ATR, up to 2 h.

family_best.title: Trend-day follow at 1 h after the NYSE open
family_best.rules: At 1 h after the NYSE open (weekdays), if price has moved at least 0.5 x the 14-day ATR from the 00:00 UTC open, follow the move at market until 00:00 UTC. Stop at the day open. Only in the direction of the last 10 days' move.
